visual_observations: Straight-on frontal view: shoulders square, both eyes evenly visible, level gaze and balanced weight.
Adult A1 identity remains recognizable with silver-gray grouped wavy hair, gray-blue eyes, original open ring clip on anatomical left/viewer-right, studs and calm closed-mouth smile.
Original ivory cropped jacket, graphite high-neck top, blue-gray layered wrap skirt, belt and hanging hardware, semi-sheer dark tights and cuffed/buckled block-heel ankle boots are preserved.
Both legs are straight, feet set a small distance apart and arms separated slightly from torso with relaxed hands.
Complete head, both hands and both boots are inside the portrait with clear margins; clean anime lines and quiet pale background.
deviations: Arm separation is modest and visually closer to about 10 degrees than the requested about 15 degrees.
Frontal re-projection slightly simplifies some hair locks and skirt folds while retaining their identity and structure.
